title: Footwork Expert - 6-Day
description: The complete JKD mobility system. Integrate Pendulum footwork for elite level entry, exit, and angle creation.

days.notes: Review all intermediate patterns. Ensure total control before adding Pendulum.
Introduction to Pendulum footwork. Master the weight shift and springy recoil.
Pendulum for angle creation. Focus on moving offline immediately after the entry.
Rest day. Pendulum is demanding on your ankles and agility.
Combining elite entry methods. Alternate between bursting and springy entries.
Rhythm and recoil. Use Rock Shuffle to setup Pendulum entries.

Author: Antoine Giniès
